context.transcript:
If you're in the market for a new vehicle, look no further than Becker's Auto Dealerships.
You can't find a better locally owned dealership than Becker's.
We're special because our sales agents are the best in the area.
They'll work hard to match you with the vehicle most suited to your needs.
And if you visit next week, you'll also be entered to win significant prizes with any purchase.
Imagine receiving free car washes for a year.
This is our biggest promotion yet and 20 winners will be selected.
context.transcript_translation:
如果你正在寻找一辆新车，别去其他地方了，来 Becker's Auto Dealerships。
你找不到比 Becker's 更好的本地拥有的经销商。
我们很特别，因为我们的销售代表是该地区最好的。
他们会努力帮你找到最适合你需求的车辆。
如果你下周光临，你还可以参与抽奖赢取丰厚的奖品，只要有任何购买。
想象一下一年免费洗车。
这是我们迄今为止最大的促销活动，将选出 20 位获奖者。
